# Scoped TestSet contract fixtures

`scoped-test-set-dtos.json` contains one representative DTO for each final scoped resource port: Exam and ChapterTest.

The fixture is contract data, not seeded product content. The two entries deliberately exercise both registered test types, both registered languages, all required fields, and explicit `null` values for every nullable field.

The canonical contract is documented in `docs/architecture/SCOPED_TEST_SET_TRANSPORT_CONTRACT.md`.
